seo.title: Plumbline: find where your funnel loses local customers
seo.description: An AI audit of every step between a Google search and a booked appointment, with a ranked list of fixes in plain language.

hero.heading: Find where your marketing loses local customers.
hero.lead: Plumbline runs an AI audit of every step between a search on Google and a booked appointment. You see where people drop off, why, and what to fix first, in plain language.

report.caption: Sample audit: a family dental clinic, last 30 days

stages.label: Opened the website
stages.note: The Google profile shows old opening hours and no booking link.

stages.label: Called or sent the form
stages.note: The contact form has 9 fields, and its button is cut off on phones.

stages.label: Booked a visit
stages.note: Calls after 5 pm go to a voicemail box that is full.

checks.heading: What the audit checks
checks.lead: We follow the path a real customer takes, from the first search to the second visit.

items.title: Being found
items.body: Your Google Business Profile, map rankings for the services you sell, reviews and how you answer them, and the directories your customers actually use.

items.title: The first click
items.body: How fast your site loads on a phone, and whether a visitor understands what you offer and where within five seconds.

items.title: Getting in touch
items.body: Call buttons, forms, chat and messaging. We test each one on real devices and time how long a reply takes.

items.title: Booking
items.body: Where the booking flow asks for too much, hides prices or leads to a dead end.

items.title: Coming back
items.body: Reminders, follow-ups and review requests that turn a first visit into a regular customer.

steps.title: Tell us about your business
steps.body: Send your website, your Google profile and the services you want more of. It takes five minutes.

steps.title: We run the audit
steps.body: Our AI checks hundreds of signals across your funnel. A person reviews every finding before it reaches you.

steps.title: You get a ranked list of fixes
steps.body: Within five business days: every leak with evidence, fixes ordered by impact and effort, and a 30-minute call to go through them.

audience.heading: Made for businesses that serve their neighborhood

closing.heading: One audit. A clear list of fixes. No retainer.
closing.body: The report is yours. Fix things yourself, or hand it to your team or your agency.
